description: The bar chart, titled "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision," compares the distribution of three categories—Context, Generated Response, and Other—across two conditions: "Standard" and an unnamed condition represented by the top bar. The horizontal axis represents the two conditions, while the vertical axis indicates the percentage of each category, with values ranging from 0% to 100%. Each bar is segmented into three colored portions: blue for "Context," orange for "Generated Response," and green for "Other," as defined by the legend at the bottom. The top bar, corresponding to the unnamed condition, shows a distribution of 60.6% for Context, 31.7% for Generated Response, and 7.7% for Other. The bottom bar, labeled "Standard," shows a distribution of 23.6% for Context, 51.1% for Generated Response, and 25.3% for Other. This indicates a significant shift in the composition of responses between the two conditions, with the "Standard" condition having a much higher proportion of "Generated Response" and "Other" compared to the top condition, which is dominated by "Context."
